AVIATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #20
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: AVIATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. ICT stands for: (1 mark)
   A. Internal Cooking Timer
   B. International Cricket Team
   C. Input Cable Tester
   D. Information and Communication Technology

2. Electricity safety rule: (1 mark)
   A. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun
   B. Ignore burnt cables
   C. Never touch live wires with wet hands
   D. Overload every socket

3. When learning Aircraft Structures, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Aircraft Structures.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Aircraft Structures.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Aircraft Structures.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Aircraft Structures.

4. When learning Navigation, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Navigation.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Navigation.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Navigation.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Navigation.

5. When learning Flight Instruments, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Flight Instruments.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Flight Instruments.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Flight Instruments.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Flight Instruments.

6. When learning Aircraft Related Drawing: Orthographic Projection, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Aircraft Related Drawing: Orthographic Projection.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Aircraft Related Drawing: Orthographic Projection.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Aircraft Related Drawing: Orthographic Projection.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Aircraft Related Drawing: Orthographic Projection.

7. When learning Aircraft Propulsion, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Aircraft Propulsion.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Aircraft Propulsion.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Aircraft Propulsion.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Aircraft Propulsion.

8. A computer’s main brain for processing is the: (1 mark)
   A. Keyboard
   B. Speaker
   C. Monitor
   D. CPU

9. When learning Flight Controls, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Flight Controls.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Flight Controls.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Flight Controls.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Flight Controls.

10. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Remove all guards
   B. Work alone with eyes closed
   C. Wear safety gear and follow instructions
   D. Run with the tool

11. When learning Hangar Safety, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Hangar Safety.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Hangar Safety.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Hangar Safety.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Hangar Safety.

12. When learning Ramp services, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Ramp services.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Ramp services.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Ramp services.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Ramp services.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Aircraft Structures and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Aircraft Propulsion and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Aircraft Related Drawing: Orthographic Projection and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Flight Controls and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
pages.answers:

====

2. C — Never touch live wires with wet hands

3. A — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Aircraft Structures.

4. A — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Navigation.

5. D — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Flight Instruments.

6. C — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Aircraft Related Drawing: Orthographic Projection.

7. B — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Aircraft Propulsion.

8. D — CPU

9. B — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Flight Controls.

10. C — Wear safety gear and follow instructions

11. B — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Hangar Safety.

12. A — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Ramp services.

Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Aircraft Structures; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.
